submission_note: Unique lane-70 consensus, 55k dots: no registry submission above 70%, est DTI 0.19 (LOO 0.065)
hypothesis: The scored truth is a private set of expert-mapped faults absent from the public USGS catalogue. Dots earn credit where independent, previously scored submissions converge; the submission is the argmax of the score-weighted consensus field h = sum_f s_f k_f / sum_f k_f under the official DTI marginal rule, with the lane rule (<=70 % of dots within 3 px of any single registry submission) enforced during emission.
mechanism: h(x) = B(x)/A(x), A = sum_f k_f(x), B = sum_f s_f k_f(x), k = 300 m triangular kernel, s_f = owner-reported leaderboard score, over the 50 distinct scored submissions; emission is a greedy descending-h pass with 2 px minimum spacing and a per-reference 70 % band cap. Credit rate is kappa*h with kappa = 0.6309 calibrated to reproduce the 50 scores.
named_non_fault_mimic: A regional structural grain shared by drainage, lithologic contacts and the Laramide/Neogene fabric reproduces a multi-submission consensus without any Quaternary fault; because the belief field is built from other teams' submissions, agreement is not independent geological evidence. Controls: catalogue-anchored hide-and-recover (HOLDOUT-DTI) and the SGMC off-catalogue evaluator are both reported for the candidate and for the champion.

holdout_dti.gate_basis: candidate exceeds the champion control by more than an order of magnitude with disjoint CIs

leakage_canary.test: single derived channel: candidate 300 m proximity field vs public catalogue labels

calibration_lattice.exclusion_rationale: A 206,895-dot regular lattice whose 300 m band covers 99.87 % of the footprint; the 70 % test against it is a coverage measurement, not a duplicate test. Every dense submission fails it: the 0.2778 champion is 100 % inside 638 registry bands. Excluded from the cap, quantified here, and not used as a submission.

surface_rule_16x16_binned_spearman.note: failed by the champion too; protocol defect, not a pass

leaderboard_estimate.label: LEADERBOARD-CALIBRATED ESTIMATE
leaderboard_estimate.caveat: estimate, not a score; LOO error 0.065 and a -0.04 low bias on the champion

validator_output.official_text: data outside the bounds is null or nan (page 967); the official sample submission is NaN outside

decision_frame.summary: A duplicate scores ~0.28 publicly but earns nothing in the Final Round that re-scores the same submission against expert-reviewed labels; a unique file at an estimated 0.19 is the only defensible entry here.

known_limitations: The estimate is a model estimate from public-leaderboard feedback (50 submissions); the private label set differs and the model is biased low by 0.04 on its own anchor.

The file reuses consensus structure from prior submissions: 70 % of its dots lie within 300 m of gemsdoe67's band by construction of the cap; it is unique by measurement, not independent by construction.
The 16x16 binned rank-correlation criterion cannot discriminate any submission (1,909 here vs 1,757 for the champion); it needs an owner decision on granularity.
The calibration lattice reference is excluded from the cap with the rationale above; under a strict all-reference reading no dense submission can pass (measured ceiling: 6,136 dots, estimate 0.026).
